charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for all morning queries (09:00-17:00). On Day 25 at 22:59, it was at nightstand_b1. The "desk_o1" pattern is strictly for work hours (09:00-17:00). For late night (22:00+), check nightstand_b1, as Tomas likely takes it to bed. Do not check desk_o1 after 17:00.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+). On Day 25 at 22:59, it was actually at cupboard_k1. The assumption that the glass stays in the bedroom at night is incorrect. Check cupboard_k1 for late night queries (22:00+). Do not check nightstand_b1 unless there is specific evidence of a move.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 or coffee_table_l1 for morning. On Day 24, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 07:59 but moved to desk_o1 by 09:18. The location is highly volatile in the morning. Check desk_o1 for queries after 09:00, as Tomas is at his desk. Check kitchen_table_k1 only for very early morning (before 08:30).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning and dining_table_d1 for evening. On Day 24, it was at desk_o1 at 10:42 and dining_table_d1 at 19:32. The "coffee_table_l1" pattern for mid-morning is incorrect; it stays at desk_o1 while Tomas works. Check desk_o1 for morning/afternoon (09:00-17:00). Check dining_table_d1 for evening (18:00-21:00).

book_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning and bed_b1 for late night. No new evidence today contradicts this. Continue checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and bed_b1 for late night (22:00+).
